fact: The secretary-general of the Ministry of Health visited the Sebkha health centre in Nouakchott-Ouest, described as a pilot centre that has digitised patients' health records with support from the European Union and the Belgian development agency, and said the whole patient pathway from consultation to discharge would be fully digitised by 2025 and the model extended to all health facilities; the fetched text carries no dateline, and the year is inferred from its statement that the CNASS would soon be set up.
title: Le centre de santé de Sabkha, un modèle de digitalisation des structures sanitaires
